patch.summary: Pipedrive migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Pipedrive by inventorying legacy crm fields, mapping them to Pipedrive objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Gmail, Slack, Microsoft Teams before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Pipedrive migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead management, pipeline management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Pipedrive; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Gmail; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when SMB and mid-market sales teams prioritizing pipeline visibility outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher.
If Pipedrive mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Freshsales before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Gmail in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Campaigns and Web Visitors remain paid add-ons on all plans; LeadBooster/Projects/Smart Docs are add-ons below Premium.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Ultimate introduces explicit caps (e.g. custom fields, teams, reports) versus the older unlimited Enterprise packaging.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher.
